breaking.change: Genre kits are removed: extension.json's kind "kit" and its entry, types and components fields are refused, og ui add no longer installs a kit into assets/ui-kits/, nothing discovers assets/ui-kits/, og ui eject no longer takes <kit>/<document>, and documents under assets/ui-kits/ no longer land in a cascade layer of their own. The rpg and shooter documents are built-in components.
breaking.fix: Use a component by the name its document declares (<RpgBackpack/>, <Killfeed/>); the screen that uses it loads it. Delete assets/ui-kits/ and the og.load.document calls naming it, or keep a document you edited as the game's own (it then replaces the built-in one of its name); og ui eject <group>/<document> (rpg/backpack) copies one to edit.

breaking.change: registerUiExtension, uiExtensionNames and the @origingame/engine/ui-extensions and @origingame/engine/extensions/* exports are removed, with the tsconfig paths og check and the project skeleton wrote for them.
breaking.fix: Delete the import; a component is a document used by name, and TypeScript helpers live in the game's own modules.

breaking.change: The materials pack is a resource pack of its own kind (extension.json kind "materials"): og ui add materials installs it into assets/materials/materials/, so its presets' ids are materials/materials/<preset>.ogt instead of ui-kits/materials/<preset>.ogt.
breaking.fix: Run og ui add materials again and write -og-material: "materials/materials/foil.ogt" (holo, burn, rarity) where a style named "ui-kits/materials/…"; delete assets/ui-kits/materials/.
